name: dataviewer
description: Web-based dataset analysis and annotation tool for robot demonstration datasets

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-$PWD/.venv}" uv sync --project ../../.. --package lerobot-annotation-api --frozen --no-default-groups --no-editable --extra analysis --extra export --extra azure --extra auth
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix ../.. ci && npm --prefix ../.. run build --workspace robotic-training-data-tool
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-$PWD/.venv}" uv run --project ../../.. --all-packages --frozen --group dev --extra analysis --extra hdf5 --extra export --extra auth --extra azure --extra openai pytest -o pythonpath=../../..
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-$PWD/.venv}" uv run --project ../../.. --all-packages --frozen --group dev ruff check src/ scripts/
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.validate:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm run test:backend
scripts.validate: npm run validate:backend && npm run validate:frontend
scripts.validate:fix: npm run lint:backend -- --fix && npm --prefix ../.. run lint:fix --workspace robotic-training-data-tool && npm --prefix ../.. run format:fix --workspace robotic-training-data-tool && npm --prefix ../.. run validate --workspace robotic-training-data-tool
